items.label: Center of intelligence
items.value: Instinctive (body center).

items.label: Direction of use
items.value: Inward: acting on oneself before wanting to transform the world.

items.label: Core issue
items.value: Anger: a tendency to repress or control through principles.

sections.title: Ego dynamics
sections.desc: Compulsion, passion, fixation, defense, ego pride, fear, desire.

items.label: Compulsion (avoidance)
items.value: Avoids anger (their own and others') and imperfection / mistakes.

items.label: Passion (vice)
items.value: Anger, often experienced as resentment toward what isn't as it should be.

items.label: Fixation
items.value: Perfectionism: the conviction that there is only one right way.

items.label: Defense mechanism
items.value: Reaction formation: turns anger/desire into acceptable opposites (discipline, forced kindness…).

items.label: Ego pride
items.value: I am upright, I am hardworking.

items.label: Basic fear
items.value: Being bad, corrupt, defective or perverse.

items.label: Basic desire
items.value: Being good, virtuous and in balance.

children.label: Self-preservation
children.value: Anxiety / worry: self-control, meticulous organization for survival.

children.label: Social
children.value: Nonadaptability / crusader: a model of righteousness, reforming institutions/society.

children.label: One-to-one (sexual)
children.value: Jealousy / warmth: perfection projected onto the partner, relational intensity.

items.label: Social style
items.value: Compliant (duty): approaches people through rules and a sense of duty.

items.label: Conflict management
items.value: Competency: sets emotions aside for a correct, objective solution.

items.label: Wings
items.value: Wing 9: calmer and more reserved. Wing 2: warmer and more helpful.

items.label: Integration (growth)
items.value: Toward 7: joy, spontaneity, curiosity, permission for pleasure.

items.label: Disintegration (stress)
items.value: Toward 4: melancholy, a feeling of being misunderstood, withdrawal, irrationality under pressure.

sections.title: Spiritual identity and core
sections.desc: Holy Idea, virtue, aspect, core, child of the soul.

items.label: Holy Idea
items.value: Holy Perfection: reality is intrinsically perfect just as it is.

items.label: Virtue
items.value: Serenity / patience.

items.label: Idealized aspect
items.value: Brilliancy: the pure intelligence of Being, wholeness and rightness.

items.label: Child of the soul
items.value: The inner Little 7: playing, exploring without being judged.

items.label: Speaking style
items.value: Preach and teach.

items.label: Communication miscommunication
items.value: Perceived as rigid or cold when the message is aimed at integrity.

items.label: Warning signs
items.value: Intense sense of personal obligation, increased physical tension.

items.label: Growth practices
items.value: Distinguishing doing right from wanting to be right, temperance, recognizing mistakes as human.

items.label: Frequent mix-ups with other types
items.value: Often confused with 6, 5 or 8 depending on context.

children.label: In love
children.value: Loyal and devoted, but critical when the ideal isn't respected.

children.label: At work
children.value: Reliable and ethical, has difficulty delegating for fear of mistakes.

levels.text: Wise realist: serenity, acceptance of reality.
Zealous critic: rigidity, focus on errors.
Obsessive compulsive: obsession with disorder, harshness.
Punitive avenger: punishment, risk of depression.

items.label: Awareness
items.value: Moving from subjective awareness (the trance of perfectionism) to self-remembering.

items.label: Spiral Dynamics
items.value: Affinity with BLUE: order, law, absolute truth, sacrifice for a higher cause.

items.label: Analogy
items.value: A polished mirror: wipes away the dust without seeing that what matters is the light it reflects.
